june: Heads-up: sales wants a clear pro/con one-pager for retention tiers + BYOK escrow for enterprise prospects. Can we agree on launch minimums for pilot? @omar @li
omar: For pilot minimums: daily signed snapshot (immutable), BYOK handshake + rotate-without-downtime, export bundle with provenance, and tiered retrieval SLAs. Keep 1y default, extended as paid add-on.
li: Agree. We also need attestation artifacts for SOC2 (signed manifests, HSM KMS logs) and a documented legal-hold override that locks objects. Legal wants chain-of-custody in exports.
ethan: From infra: hot 0-30d in-memory index (P95 <= 300ms), warm 31-365d column store (P95 <= 3s), cold >365d NDJSON in object store, retrieval SLA 24-72h depending on tier. Escrow: we can export key-wrapping metadata but full escrow (third-party key custody) adds compliance + ops.
june: Tradeoffs note: escrow reduces our liability but increases complexity. Sales prefer escrow as a checkbox. Legal-bot: Recommended clause template for escrow added to drive: https://docs.redwood.com/legal/escrow-template.md
omar: Acceptance criteria (pilot): 1) snapshots generated daily and immutably stored; 2) snapshot manifests cryptographically signed and auditable; 3) BYOK handshake returns proof-of-possession attestation; 4) export includes access-log bundle; 5) feature-flag per-tenant.
li: Also require a compromise playbook: revoke + re-encrypt + notify + audit trail. Add that to runbook before pilot.
ethan: I'll add engineering tasks: index migration tool, tenant feature flag, async retrieval worker, key-escrow experiment. ETA rough: 6-8 weeks for core + BYOK basic, 10-12 wks for escrow option.
june: Can sales sell pilot before escrow is ready? Likely yes if we state escrow roadmap and sign indemnity. Need one-pager that maps features to SLAs and pricing add-ons.
omar: I'll draft the one-pager. Action items: omar -> one-pager + acceptance criteria; li -> compromise playbook + SOC2 attestation checklist; ethan -> rough timeline + infra tickets; june -> coordinate with sales and pilot customers. ops-bot: Created JIRA RET-21456 assigned to omar, li, ethan. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RET-21456
june: Thanks. We'll sync in Friday PM sync to finalize the one-pager. End of thread.
